main_text.p: mus nos quidem satis, quantæ impietatis sit, Deo cœli supponere humani ingenij fœtus; nec quid mouere nos potest Anathematis Tridentini inanis crepitatiuncula; cum tonantem audimus Deum, Si quis apposuerit ad hæc, apponet Deus illi plagas scriptas in hoc libro.Si quis libr. Hester, Dan. Baruc. Eccl. Sap. Iudith. Tob. Macab. pro Canonicis non recep. Anathema sit. Sess. 4. Apoc. vlt.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. Faint show-through text from the reverse page (left and lower right) is omitted. The marginal note at lower right is too faint to read and is omitted. The margin note's letters are italic and partly obscured; "Apoc. vlt." is read as printed.
